question: Should the built-in Orgo provider require an operator-managed workspace and permanently avoid workspace deletion?
rationale: Orgo’s cascading workspace deletion has no documented conditional precondition, so automatic workspace ownership cannot be made concurrency-safe through another local inventory check; changing to operator-managed workspaces is a user-visible provider contract.

options.title: Require managed workspace
options.body: Make an existing workspace ID mandatory, manage only exact claimed computers, and never call workspace deletion.

options.title: Defer provider
options.body: Pause the built-in provider until Orgo offers conditional or non-cascading workspace deletion.

options.title: Keep integration external
options.body: Close the built-in proposal and leave Orgo support to a custom external integration.

recommendation.title: Require managed workspace
recommendation.body: Make an existing workspace ID mandatory, manage only exact claimed computers, and never call workspace deletion.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the deepest recent implementation, lifecycle-safety, and provider credential context for this decision.
